```python
def flop_count_str(flops: FlopCountAnalysis, activations: Optional[
    ActivationCountAnalysis]=None) ->str:
    """
    Format the per-module parameters and flops of a model as a string.
    
    Args:
        flops (FlopCountAnalysis): the flop counting object
        activations (ActivationCountAnalysis or None): If given, include
            activation counts in the output.
    
    Returns:
        str : The formatted string representation of the model with statistics.
    """
    model = flops._model
    
    # Disable warnings
    flops.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
    flops.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
    flops.tracer_warnings("none")
    
    # Get statistics
    params = dict(parameter_count(model))
    flops_dict = flops.by_module()
    
    stats = {"#params": params, "#flops": flops_dict}
    
    if activations is not None:
        activations.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
        activations.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
        activations.tracer_warnings("none")
        stats["#acts"] = activations.by_module()
    
    # Reorganize statistics by module
    stats = _group_by_module(stats)
    
    # Remove zero statistics but keep root
    stats = _remove_zero_statistics(stats, force_keep={""})
    
    # Pretty print statistics
    stats = _pretty_statistics(stats)
    
    # Mark uncalled modules
    stats = _indicate_uncalled_modules(
        stats,
        "#flops",
        flops.uncalled_modules() & stats.keys(),
        uncalled_indicator="N/A",
    )
    
    if activations is not None:
        stats = _indicate_uncalled_modules(
            stats,
            "#acts",
            activations.uncalled_modules() & stats.keys(),
            uncalled_indicator="N/A",
        )
    
    # Create model string with statistics
    model_str = _model_stats_str(model, stats)
    
    # Get input sizes
    input_sizes = _get_input_sizes(flops._inputs)
    
    # Build output string
    output_lines = [model_str]
    output_lines.append("")
    output_lines.append("Input size: " + str(input_sizes))
    output_lines.append("")
    output_lines.append("N/A indicates a possibly missing statistic due to not tracing the module.")
    
    return "\n".join(output_lines)
```
